```yaml
name: Claude Review

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test-cli:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Create dummy sbatch script
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/bin
          cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/bin/sbatch
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          echo "Dummy sbatch called with: $@"
          exit 0
          EOF
          chmod +x /tmp/bin/sbatch
        env:
          PATH: /tmp/bin:$PATH

      - name: Run script with CLI args
        run: |
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --slurm --account test_account --partition test_partition --job_dir /tmp/job_dir --custom_mounts /tmp/mount
        env:
          PATH: /tmp/bin:$PATH

      - name: Run script with env var fallback
        run: |
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --slurm
        env:
          ACCOUNT: test_account
          PARTITION: test_partition
          NEMORUN_HOME: /tmp/nemorun_home
          CUSTOM_MOUNTS: /tmp/custom_mounts
          PATH: /tmp/bin:$PATH
```
